Product.title: Product
Product.description: A souvenir product sold in the boutique with real-time stock tracking.

ownerId.description: Authenticated store owner UID scoping multi-tablet synchronization.

name.description: Display name of the souvenir product.

volume.description: Optional volume or weight specification displayed beneath the product name (e.g. 250ml, 100g).

price.description: Regular card unit price in Euros (€).

isPopular.description: Whether the item displays the popular item marker.

imageUrl.description: Asset URL or compressed thumbnail data URI.

displayOrder.description: Numeric ordering priority in the catalog grid.

bundleEnabled.description: Whether multi-unit bundle pricing is enabled for this product.

bundleQuantity.description: Minimum quantity threshold for bundle pricing (integer >= 2 when enabled, 0 when disabled).

bundlePrice.description: Total Euro price for bundleQuantity units; additional units above threshold add bundlePrice / bundleQuantity each.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when product was registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when product was last modified.

TeamSummary.title: TeamSummary
TeamSummary.description: Aggregated counter and sales totals for a package tour team code.

teamCode.description: Normalized uppercase package tour team code.

orderCount.description: Total completed checkout count used to issue sequential order numbers (#1, #2, ...).

totalCardAmount.description: Cumulative Euro revenue paid by card.

totalCashAmount.description: Cumulative Euro revenue paid by cash (5% discounted).

totalRevenue.description: Cumulative total Euro revenue for this team.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of the team's first recorded purchase.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the team's most recent purchase.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: An individual numbered checkout transaction belonging to a tour team.

teamDocId.description: Document ID reference to the parent teams document.

teamCode.description: Normalized uppercase package tour team code.

orderNumber.description: Sequential guest checkout number within the team (#1, #2, ...).

paymentMethod.description: Payment method: card (regular price), cash (5% discount), or mixed (manual card + cash split at regular price).

cardAmount.description: Portion paid by card in Euros (required/used for mixed payments).

cashAmount.description: Portion paid by cash in Euros (required/used for mixed payments).

items.description: Bounded list of purchased product line items (1 to 50 items).

totalQuantity.description: Total number of product units purchased in this transaction.

originalTotal.description: Regular card subtotal in Euros before cash discount.

discountAmount.description: Discount amount in Euros (0 for card/mixed, 5% for cash).

StoreSettings.title: StoreSettings
StoreSettings.description: Store-wide commission rate settings synced across all boutique tablets.

guideRate.description: Legacy tour guide commission percentage synced with cash rate (0 to 100, default 10).

leaderRate.description: Legacy tour leader commission percentage synced with cash rate (0 to 100, default 10).

guideCashRate.description: Tour guide commission percentage for cash payments (0 to 100, default 10).

guideCardRate.description: Tour guide commission percentage for card payments (0 to 100, default 9).

leaderCashRate.description: Tour leader commission percentage for cash payments (0 to 100, default 10).

leaderCardRate.description: Tour leader commission percentage for card payments (0 to 100, default 9).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were last modified.

/products/{productId}.description: Boutique product catalog with real-time stock counts.

/teams/{teamDocId}.description: Tour team aggregate counters and sequential order numbering.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Individual numbered guest purchases tied to a tour team.

/settings/{settingsId}.description: Store commission rate settings scoped by owner UID.
